description: Synthetic paper fixture: hl-strict-btc booked in the paper partition with the version 1 paper cost model (taker fee, adverse SlippagePct, no spread) over the frozen window.

interval.evidence: the frozen market window 'comparison'; booked events are compared when their ledger record time falls inside it

rule_inputs.base_evidence: synthetic fixture: strategies.initial_capital for hl-strict-btc is 1000 and no cash flow other than booked trades and funding touched the strategy

cash_usd.evidence: initial capital plus the ledger delta of every booked event before the interval start

inventory.evidence: every booked position before the interval start is fully closed in the export

pending_decision.evidence: the strategy signal on the last warm-up bar, recomputed from the frozen candles

timeline.evidence: synthetic fixture: source/config.json is the only configuration this strategy ever ran with; it is the effective (post-load) configuration, unchanged since 2026-01-01
